input: Connect Phantom, then Send 1 USDC, answered by a stand-in Phantom (same encryption, an empty throwaway wallet)
outcome: “Phantom connected”; balances load; a token's address is refused; the signed send reaches Solana, which turns it down for no SOL, said in plain words

input: Buy chip → panel (balance from the relay, held assets as chips, typed amount with 25%/50%/Max, live Jupiter “≈ 88.2B Bonk”) → Buy
outcome: Glyf flashes only to open Phantom (“Opening Phantom…”); an empty wallet is refused in plain words with Try again; back in the chat the keyboard says how it went

input: typed “send 20 usdc to 2YkE…” → Send chip → panel ($20 USDC → Wallet, SOL/USDC chips, Private by MagicBlock, own 1-0/25%/50%/Max pad) → Send
outcome: The panel replaces the keys and types its own digits; Send hands to the app, which answers “Connect Phantom first” when no wallet is linked

title: App Review signs in with the password from App Store Connect
input: sign-in screen → three quick taps on the orb → Reviewer password (POST /auth/review) → Sign in
outcome: One shared review account (review@tryglyf.com) with a month of Max, straight to home; a wrong password says so, ten misses an hour; the door is shut until REVIEW_PASSWORD is set
